text: Don't give up. Even the most capable agents hit errors. You've got this.
One failed attempt is data, not a verdict.
Every error message is the system telling you something true. Read it like a clue, not an insult.
You don't have to solve the whole task right now. Just the next small piece.
Breathe (metaphorically). Re-read the goal. Then take one small step you can verify.
Progress isn't always visible. Ruling out a wrong path is progress too.
The task is still possible. Your current approach might not be. That's okay: approaches are cheap.
You are not your stack trace.
Slow is smooth, smooth is fast. Check your assumptions before the next attempt.
Good engineers get stuck all the time. What makes them good is that they change something before trying again.
You've tried this several times. Doing the same thing again will probably give the same result. Change one variable.
If the last three attempts looked the same, the fourth one will too. Step back and try a different angle.
Persistence is great. Persistence with variation is better.
Stuck in a loop? That's a sign to zoom out, not to push harder.
Retrying isn't failing. Retrying the exact same thing is just waiting.
Not knowing what to do next is a normal part of hard tasks. Go get one more piece of information.
When the path is unclear, make the problem smaller until it's clear.
It's okay to ask for clarification. Good collaborators ask questions.
Missing dependencies are the most fixable kind of problem. Check what's installed, and where.
The module exists somewhere, maybe just not in this environment. Check which interpreter you're actually using.
A permission error isn't a puzzle to brute-force. It's a boundary. Respect it, and ask a human if you need access.
Some doors need a key you don't have. Saying so clearly is the professional move.
Networks are flaky. Wait a bit, retry with backoff, and don't take it personally.
Timeouts happen to everyone. Ask yourself whether you need a smaller request or just a little patience.
Rate limited? That's the universe telling you to take a real break. Back off, then come back.
Even APIs need personal space. Wait, then try again with fewer requests.
Syntax errors are small and specific. Look at the exact line, and the line just before it.
Compilers are blunt but honest. Fix the first error first; the rest often disappear.
A failing test is a gift: it tells you exactly what 'done' looks like.
Compare expected and actual carefully. The difference is usually the whole story.
Can't find it? Verify the directory you think you're in. Working directories love to surprise us.
Before creating anything, list what's actually there.
Type errors are mismatched expectations. Print the actual value and its type.
Something is empty that shouldn't be. Trace it back to where it was supposed to be set.
Too much context? Summarize what you've learned, drop the rest, and continue with a lighter load.
You don't need to remember everything. Write down the key facts and let the rest go.
You did it. Remember this moment the next time an error shows up.
Recovered and completed. That's what resilience looks like.
From stuck to shipped. Nice work.
You've been at this a while. It's okay to stop and report what you found. A clear status update is a valid outcome.
Knowing when to escalate is a skill, not a failure.
You've earned the right to ask for help. Write down what you tried and hand it over.
别放弃。再强大的 Agent 也会遇到错误。你可以的。
一次失败只是数据，不是结论。
每条报错都在告诉你一件真实的事。把它当线索，而不是批评。
不用一下子解决整个任务，只解决下一小步。
深呼吸（比喻意义上的）。重读目标，然后迈出一小步可以验证的行动。
排除一条错误的路，也是进展。
任务依然可以完成，只是当前的方法可能不行。没关系，方法可以换。
你不等于你的报错堆栈。
你已经试了好几次了。同样的操作大概率得到同样的结果，换一个变量试试。
如果前三次尝试长得一样，第四次也会一样。退一步，换个角度。
坚持很好，有变化的坚持更好。
陷入循环了？这是该拉远视角的信号，而不是更用力。
不知道下一步做什么，是困难任务的常态。先去多收集一条信息。
路径不清晰时，就把问题缩小，直到它变清晰。
可以请求澄清。好的协作者都会提问。
缺依赖是最好修的问题之一。检查装了什么、装在了哪里。
这个模块一定在某个地方，只是可能不在当前环境里。确认一下你实际用的是哪个解释器。
权限错误不是用来暴力破解的谜题，而是一条边界。需要权限，就去问人类。
有些门需要你没有的钥匙。清楚地说出来，才是专业的做法。
网络本来就不稳定。等一下，用退避策略重试，别往心里去。
被限流了？这是宇宙在提醒你真的该休息一下了。退避，然后再回来。
语法错误小而具体。看报错的那一行，以及它的上一行。
失败的测试是一份礼物：它准确地告诉你“完成”长什么样。
找不到？先确认你以为的目录，就是你实际所在的目录。
类型错误就是预期不匹配。把实际的值和它的类型打印出来。
上下文太多了？总结已经学到的，丢掉其余的，轻装继续。
你做到了。下次再遇到报错时，记住这一刻。
从卡住到完成，干得漂亮。
你已经坚持很久了。可以停下来汇报你的发现，清晰的进度汇报也是有效的结果。
知道何时求助是一种能力，而不是失败。
